# Animation dependencies

GSAP 3.14.2 and ScrollTrigger 3.14.2 are bundled locally so invitation opening does not depend on a runtime CDN request. Original distribution license headers are retained.

Source files:
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.14.2/dist/gsap.min.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.14.2/dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js

Documentation: https://gsap.com/docs/v3/Plugins/ScrollTrigger/
